text: This trajectory takes a spacecraft from Earth to a target planet, departing on March 13, 2030 and arriving on March 13, 2050, with a total flight time of about 20 years. The spacecraft leaves Earth with a hyperbolic excess speed of 41.6 km/s, meaning it will be traveling that fast relative to Earth once it escapes Earth’s gravity. Once it reaches the target planet, it will approach at a relative speed of about 16.9 km/s, and after the encounter it will be moving away from the planet at roughly the same speed, 16.9 km/s. The departure C₃ value of 1727.9 km²/s² characterizes the energy of the departure hyperbola in Earth‑relative terms.
